dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: International Big-Data Center for Depression Research (IBCDR) - a multi-site dataset collected from multiple hospitals/institutions in China (http://yanlab.psych.ac.cn/IBCDR). Original sample included 1276 MDDs and 1104 healthy controls, from which 274 FEDN-MDDs and 832 healthy controls meeting criteria were selected. The healthy controls were divided into three groups: healthy-ICA (125), healthy-base (289), and healthy-comparison (418).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: We employed data from International Big-Data Center for Depression Research, and the data were collected from multiple hospitals/institutions in China (http://yanlab.psych.ac.cn/IBCDR).

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: The healthy controls (832 total) were divided into three separate groups to avoid data reuse: (1) healthy-ICA group (125 participants) for creating group-level ICA components; (2) healthy-base group (289 participants) for establishing the normative model; (3) healthy-comparison group (418 participants) for statistical comparison with FEDN-MDD patients. FEDN-MDD patients (274) were used as the clinical study cohort.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: 4) 125 healthy control individuals (71 females, as a healthy-ICA group) of 832 controls were included to create the group level components using GIG-ICA; 5) Another 289 healthy control individuals (165 female, as a healthy-base group) of 832 controls were included to establish a normative model; 6) 274 FEDN-MDD individuals (174 males) and the rest 418 healthy control individuals (232 males, as a healthy-comparison group) recruited from the same study sites were included to conduct statistical analyses.

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: The normative model was built using only the healthy-base group (289 participants). A 10-fold cross-validation procedure was used where 90% of the 289 healthy-base participants were used for training each fold, with the remaining 10% withheld for validation.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: Another 289 healthy control individuals (165 female, as a healthy-base group) of 832 controls were included to establish a normative model ... We repeatedly trained the polynomial regression model on 90 % of the 289 healthy-base participants at different percentiles, withholding the remaining 10 % for estimating generalization performance.

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: The healthy-base group used for normative model construction had mean age 28.83 ± 9.19 years. The inclusion criteria specified age range of 18-50 years. The train-phase statistics are not reported separately as 10-fold CV was used with random splits.
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: FEDN-MDD aged from 18 to 50 were included ... healthy controls with age in a range of 18 to 50 were included ... Table 1: Healthy-base group: 28.83 ± 9.19

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: The healthy-base group (289 participants) used for normative model construction included 165 females (57.1%) and 124 males (42.9%). Male count calculated as 289 - 165 = 124. Train-phase sex breakdown is not reported separately as 10-fold CV used random splits.
